channel.title: Codelogium
channel.description: Codelogium is Al-Fahami Toihir's learning journal: notes on CS fundamentals, C, Java, Spring and real-world engineering, written while figuring it out.

item.title: Week 0
item.description: My notes from CS50 Week 0: why foundations still matter in the age of AI, how computers represent information, and what makes an algorithm good.

item.title: Why My MkDocs Article Showed 11 Months Ago as Creation Date
item.author: Al-Fahami Toihir
item.description: A full debugging story of why a brand new article was showing 11 months ago as its creation date on a MkDocs Material site, and everything I tried before finding the real fix.

item.title: Java Generics
item.description: Explore how Java generics work across interfaces, classes, and multi-type scenarios with real examples.

item.title: Daily Commands
item.description: The git commands you use every day: init, add, commit, status, .gitignore, aliases, and commit message conventions.

item.title: Branches & Stash
item.description: Branching strategies, stash workflows, reverting commits, resetting history, and inspecting specific commits.

item.title: Troubleshooting
item.description: Real git issues encountered during development; root causes, investigation steps, and fixes.

item.title: Remotes & Workflows
item.description: Push, pull, SSH setup, fork workflows, multiple Git identities, divergent branches, skip-worktree, assume-unchanged, LFS, and gist transfer.

item.title: BCertificate
item.description: A Hyperledger Fabric blockchain network that automates the issuance, dispatch, and management of university digital credentials; diplomas, transcripts, and degree certifications.

item.title: LandCertificate
item.description: A Hyperledger Fabric blockchain application where clients request land certificates from a land conserver (admin) who certifies ownership on the blockchain; with QR code verification and MongoDB Atlas for request storage.

item.title: Crypto Portfolio API
item.description: A Spring Boot microservices-style API for managing cryptocurrency portfolios; integrating with CoinMarketCap via WebClient for real-time exchange rates.
